optimized_sql:
WITH title_filter AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    WHERE t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
      AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
),
mi_filter AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE it.info = 'release dates'
      AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
      AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
),
mc_filter AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id, mc.company_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    WHERE mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
      AND mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%'
    UNION
    SELECT mc.movie_id, mc.company_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    WHERE mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
      AND mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%'
),
ci_filter AS (
    SELECT ci.movie_id, ci.person_id, ci.role_id, ci.person_role_id
    FROM cast_info AS ci
    WHERE ci.note = '(voice)'
),
movie_links AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id,
           mc.company_id,
           ci.person_id,
           ci.role_id,
           ci.person_role_id
    FROM mi_filter AS mi
    JOIN mc_filter AS mc ON mc.movie_id = mi.movie_id
    JOIN ci_filter AS ci ON ci.movie_id = mi.movie_id
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress,
       MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM title_filter AS t
JOIN movie_links AS ml ON ml.movie_id = t.id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = ml.company_id AND cn.country_code = '[us]'
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ml.person_id AND n.gender = 'f' AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.id = ml.role_id AND rt.role = 'actress'
JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ml.person_role_id
JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id
